files.description: EHI export format specification. 3-page PDF listing 28 C-CDA clinical data sections (with HL7 template IDs) exported by Tenzing VistA, plus 4 McKesson Series billing data sections. This is the registered (b)(10) documentation URL.

EHI export user guide / operational instructions. 4-page PDF documenting the two VistA menu options for performing EHI exports: VGTM EHI EXPORT (interactive) and VGTM AUTO CCDA EXPORT (scheduled batch). Includes screenshots of the VistA terminal interface and task parameter configuration. Found via the ONC cert page at http://www.tenzingmedical.com/onc-cert.
